_about: Heartside's adapter for the revenue desk: the method lives once in ai-harness, the deterministic code in strategist, and this file says where each step from post to money is read in this engine. It holds no figures and no customer data: every count is an aggregate this engine already keeps. The desk reads, computes and proposes; it never posts, sends or spends. AGENTS.md, "Revenue desk".
ruling: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-24): build the revenue desk as recommended; thresholds from this engine's own history binding only after his yes.

skill.name: revenue-desk
skill.read_with: Control Center get_skill('revenue-desk'); until it is admitted, a local ai-harness checkout's skills/revenue-desk, else record the desk as unavailable and change nothing

north_star.state_line: NOW.md, the north-star-state line under "Where it is right now"

blind_rule: A step that is unreadable, missing or older than freshness_days is blind, recorded with its reason, never as zero. A venture with any blind step never reads on track or clear.

steps.name: post
steps.counts: posts recorded live in the creative ledger, by creative id

read.what: the newest revision of every creative with status published
where a live post is recorded as published, with its address

steps.name: session
steps.counts: store sessions, and sessions credited to one exact creative id through its tracked link

read.what: shopify_utm sessions filtered to one exact utm_content creative id
store sessions from imported aggregate reports, over nonoverlapping windows

steps.name: add to cart
steps.counts: sessions with a cart addition, store wide
steps.read_gap: Neither engine/attribution.py nor engine/insights.py reads cart additions: attribution reads orders only, and insights allows sessions, orders and net sales on a creative but no cart field. So this step is store wide, cannot be sliced by creative, and is blind whenever no aggregate report covers the window.

steps.name: order
steps.counts: orders whose journey classifies as organic posts (engine plus organic social), and per creative where the link was tracked

read.what: orders per tier and per engine family, paid checked first and never counted
attributed orders on one exact creative revision

steps.name: net sales
steps.counts: net sales attributed to organic posts, trailing 28 days, the North Star number
steps.measure: value per order and the trailing total

read.what: organic net sales in the newest trailing_28d reading, with observed_at
net sales per tier and per engine family, under the definition attribution.py states

bands.label: assumption
bands.calibrate_from: this engine's own history only: the stored attribution readings, the imported aggregate reports and the insights observations, back-tested so the bands flag what later stalled and nothing in the control weeks
bands.binding_after: Krish's yes on the calibrated bands, recorded as a Ruling in the commit that sets them
bands.repeat_breach: two breaches of the same step in a row raise one ask, inside the ask limits
bands.until_binding: a crossed band is shown as an observation on the sheet, never as an alarm on his list

blind.action: Restore the reading: run the step's read command, or name the access it lacks, before any other step is judged.

warning.action: Slice the step by source, gift, creative family and week, and name the one slice that carries the drop on the sheet.

breach.action: Write one 7-day test card for that step (hypothesis, one variable, primary and guardrail metric, floor, expected and stretch, stop and kill rule, review date) and propose it as a plan behind strategy.

rules: Gift prices come only from the canon's configured baseline sentences, never a hardcoded list; sources that disagree mark the gift and it is never offered.
Purchase copy or a public price declares its offers: gift id, quantity from 1 to 20 and unit price.
Purchase copy needs a public catalog sync less than 26 hours old.
A discount needs a second distinct gift and bundle evidence verified at the same sync; a canon sentence alone never proves it.
Every quoted price matches a declared gift price or the basket total.
Copy that names a gift declares that gift.
A purchase link leads to its declared gift or to a ready gifts landing page, and is tracked.
Discount codes count only in a family Krish registered in config/codes.json.
offer_terms.rerun: whenever a go_live payload is built, before its payload_sha256 is computed
offer_terms.role: a validator before the existing walls, never a new wall

paid_boosts.note: Paid never counts toward any step: attribution.py runs its paid checks first. A boost keeps its own proposal and Krish's yes on that exact boost.

store_job.rule: The store job stays off the schedule and runs only when Krish names it; the desk never puts it back.

asks.route: Control Center's one list, behind strategy, folded into the Sunday board memo
asks.midweek: only when a step newly goes blind or newly breaches a binding band
asks.while_open: no new ask while one is open in the protocol journal
asks.approval: a yes on a test card is plan approval only; anything it produces keeps its own go_live with a matching payload_sha256

privacy: Aggregates only. No order, customer, dog or typed answer reaches a sheet (AGENTS.md, rule 6).
